high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of a social media post from the account "info.cosmos." The post is titled "SCIENTIST CLAIMS THAT ALIENS MAY BE COMMUNICATING VIA STARLIGHT" and features an illustration of a person's face with an alien-like figure superimposed on one side. The text below the title reads: "According to Imperial College London quantum physicist Terry Rudolph, an advanced extraterrestrial civilization might alter the light coming off stars in order to communicate across great distance, almost like a series of interstellar smoke signals.
